name: Mayal Hotel Restaurant
why_it_matters: In-house dining at Mayal Hotel — one of Namchi's longest-standing town hotels. The default sit-down lunch stop for tourists doing the Char Dham–Samdruptse statue–Namchi loop. Decent Sikkimese thali alongside reliable Indian-Chinese.
insider_tip: Lunch is busy 1-2.30pm with Char Dham tour groups; arrive by 12.30 for a quiet table. Non-residents welcome but the hotel restaurant prefers a call-ahead for dinner.
signature_address: Mayal Hotel, Namchi Town, Namchi 737126, South Sikkim

name: Cherry Resort Restaurant
signature_dish: Sikkimese set meal with tea-estate view
why_it_matters: Restaurant inside Cherry Resort, set within Temi Tea Garden — Sikkim's only tea estate. The view-meal pairing (Kanchenjunga-facing tea slopes) is the draw, not just the food. Sikkimese set meals on a fixed lunch menu.
insider_tip: Non-residents must reserve — security gates the property. Lunch (12.30-2.30pm) is when Temi catches the best light; ask for the verandah.
signature_address: Cherry Resort, Temi Tea Estate, near Namchi 737134, South Sikkim
